properties.description: The address watch's network half. A real reflow2 serves a design over HTTP (the /g/<id>/mcp shape flo2.io serves); a watch declared at its address sees it unchanged, sees a real upstream write as moved, imports nothing, and reads a stopped server as unreachable. Stand-ins cover a 401 refusal (in the server's words, key never in the reply), no key set up (the reply says how to set one up), a reply that is not a design (unreadable), a key never sent in the clear, a hosted server never reaching out, loop_status never calling out, and a two-place watch refused before any call.
properties.name: tests/a_design_is_watched_at_the_server_that_holds_it.rs
